Order 
Notice has been served upon the mother of the victim.

This is third bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 373/2022 registered at Police Station - Narwar, District - Shivpuri for the offence under Section 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act, 2012.

First & second bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn vide orders dated 13.03.2023, 26.02.2024 passed in M.CrC.
No.2339/2023 & M.CrC. No.21568/2023 respectively.

2 . Learned counsel for the applicant contends that after dismissal of previous applications,
statement of the prosecutrix as well as her mother have been recorded and both of them have not supported the allegations levelled by prosecution, therefore, in view of the subsequent event where the present applicant has not been implicated, deserves to be enlarged on bail as NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:2516 2 MCRC-2108-2025 he is in custody since 14.12.2022.

3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that offence has been committed against a minor, therefore, considering the nature of allegation, no case for Sirsu@Shishupal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130216827/
1 grant of bail is made out.

entities.text: Sirsu@Shishupal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Considering the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and perusal of the record reflects that the prosecutrix as well as her mother have not supported the case of prosecution and turned hostile, the applicant is in custody since 24.12.2022.
Thus, considering the totality of the circumstances, the application is allowed.

5. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned their appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.

6. It is further directed that the applicants shall comply with the provisions of Section 480 (3) of the BNSS, 2023.
7.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.

(MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE vpn/-
